settings.question: Is it a crash restraint?
settings.answer: No. It protects your seats and gives your dog a flat surface to lie on. It is not crash-tested. Use a proper harness or crate if you want crash protection.

settings.question: What if it doesn’t work out?
settings.answer: Send it back within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. It can show honest use, but it needs to be clean and dry.
